title: Inference Landscape Prospectus & Decision Heuristics for Model Procurement
creator: Sofia Alvarez
description: Create a tactical prospectus and reusable decision heuristics to operationalize continuous competitive intelligence and vendor procurement for model capacity decisions. Output is a single canonical deliverable (Prospectus + Scoring Workbook) that product, procurement, and platform teams can use to decide when to: a) onboard a new model variant, b) provision dedicated capacity, or c) activate fallbacks across region/hardware. The work must stitch signals from benchmarks, vendor roadmaps, pricing telemetry, and live usage patterns into prioritized triggers and runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Prospectus doc (Confluence) with market map, vendor maturity profiles, and provisioning triggers
Scoring workbook (CSV/Google Sheet) with normalized metrics: latency delta, cost-per-token delta, quantization compatibility, hardware affinity, regulatory fit, and rollback risk score
Decision heuristics card (one-pager) for on-call/platform to enact fallback or capacity changes
Integration checklist for telemetry ingestion (benchmarks, GH issues, vendor bulletins) and owners assigned
Stakeholder review completed with Product, Research, Platform, and Solutions; sign-off captured in comments
notes: This aims to fill gaps between ongoing model scouting artifacts and procurement triggers — make it actionable for sales-assisted Dedicated deals and Private deployments.
We will prioritize signals that have high precision for operational outcomes (latency regressions, cost overrun, or regulatory incompatibility).
Scope excludes negotiating commercial terms — outcome should feed procurement playbook with clear trigger thresholds.
Use existing benchmark corpus (repo: github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks) and the model-compat-collector pipeline as sources.
